paper_title: PAPPA2 c.392G>C Heterozygous Mutation Associates Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma in a Chinese Family
study_design: Family-initiated investigation with variant-expression, primary human cell and mouse experiments; this page evaluates the experimental findings
evidence_type: Experimental preclinical evidence with an explicitly unvalidated family-wide segregation component
claim: PAPPA2 c.392G>C expression was associated with lower PAPPA2 protein levels in transfected 293T cells and their culture supernatant, without a statistically significant mRNA difference from wild type.
context: Equal amounts of wild-type and mutant expression plasmids were compared 48 hours after transfection. The variant encodes p.Gly131Ala; protein abundance measurements do not directly measure protein half-life or human disease penetrance.

limitations: ["Results 3.1-3.2 describe a family association, but the Figure 1a caption does not fully specify which depicted relatives contribute to the reported counts, and Figure 2a-b provides representative Sanger traces rather than an individual-level genotype table.
